summary.intent: Execute all 7 plans in Phase 65 (SDK write-chain, bin re-link, and invite claim) using wave-based parallel worktree execution, then run the full ship-phase loop autonomously to get a reviewed, green PR ready to merge.
summary.outcome: All 7 plans executed across 4 waves with all gates green; PR #583 opened at final SHA 92ee561f5 (after addressing greptile's serialization bug) with all CI green, 20 original review threads resolved, and a real runtime bug in bin serialization caught and fixed by greptile post-ship.

repo: Write plane is keyed by node UUID (childId), read plane by IPNS name — shared-write ops that filter children must use the right key per plane or silently skip/corrupt entries (the deleteFromSharedFolder bug)

encryptBinMetadata/decryptBinMetadata are documented to handle Uint8Array ↔ hex conversion but didn't — Uint8Array fields JSON.stringify to {"0":..} object form, making restoreFromBin throw at sealChildReadKey at runtime; fixed by hex-encoding at the encrypt seam
The sdk-e2e TEST_LOGIN_SECRET is 'e2e-test-secret-ci-only' (apps/api/.env), not the default 'e2e-test-secret-do-not-use-in-production' — mismatch causes 401 on first live run
pnpm typecheck runs the full build chain (crypto→core→api-client→sdk-core→sdk→web→scripts) and catches cross-package consumer breakage that per-plan worktree tests miss

rotateWriteFromNode tombstone ordering bug: child tombstones were being fired before the parent was re-pointed; fix collects pendingTombstones[] in rotateWriteSubtree and fires them only after the full subtree publishes

publishNodeFn seam in client.ts must use addToIpfs directly for IPNS node metadata (not pinWithMode) because BYO/external pinning mode skips cipherbox pinning, which would break IPNS resolution; only encrypted content goes through pinWithMode

Pre-existing sdk-e2e type errors exist in other suites (batch-upload, ipns-consistency, file-operations) from a prior metadata refactor removing FolderChild/FilePointer/SealedChildRef.id/.type — not phase-65 regressions

rotateWriteFromNode was added to rotation/index.ts by 65-06 but not re-exported from the sdk-core top-level barrel (src/index.ts) — caught when the e2e suite couldn't import it; the 65-07 executor added the 2-line barrel fix as a Rule-3 deviation
husky pre-commit hook is slow enough (45+ seconds) to cause commands to timeout at exit 143 while the commit actually lands — always verify with git log --oneline -1 before retrying
gh pr edit is broken on this repo (Projects-classic GraphQL) — patch PR body via 'gh api -X PATCH repos/FSM1/cipher-box/pulls/<N> -F body=@file' instead

code.finding: fromBinWireForm decoded hex without length validation — a wrong-length hex still yielded a Uint8Array reaching key-sealing; added 32-byte length check after decode

encryptBinMetadata/decryptBinMetadata did plain JSON.stringify/parse, serializing Uint8Array nodeReadKey to {"0":..} object form; fixed to hex-encode on write and hex-decode+validate on read using bytesToHex/hexToBytes from @cipherbox/crypto

CannotWriteUntilRefetchError thrown at lines 238, 348, 487 when publishNodeFn returns {tombstoned: true} — proves WRITE-03; also deleteFromSharedFolder was filtering write-body by ipnsName (IPNS string) instead of childId (UUID), so the WriteChildRef stale entry was never removed and would crash rotateWriteFromNode

rotateWriteSubtree collected pendingTombstones[] instead of firing inline; rotateWriteFromNode fires them after full subtree is published (child-first ordering, parent re-pointed first). newKeypair.privateKey zeroed at line 1389, rootResult.newWriteKey zeroed at 1390 after grants loop

buildSharedWriteContext still used old folderKey/ipnsPrivateKey shape after 65-04 reshaped SharedWriteContext to readKey/writeKey/publishedNode/publishNodeFn/addToIpfsFn — caught by post-merge typecheck, not by the per-plan worktree tests
Added optional writeKey?/publishedNode? to SeedSharedFolderArgs with PLACEHOLDER_PUBLISHED_NODE sentinel so existing web callers typecheck without Phase-68 wiring changes

buildSharedWriteContextFromState wires addToIpfsFn via this.sdkCore.addToIpfs (not pinWithMode) for published node metadata — metadata must stay on cipherbox IPFS for IPNS resolution; only content uses pinWithMode for BYO pinning support
deleteFromSharedFolder is a public boundary — omitting childNodeId would remove the read-body entry but leave WriteChildRef stale in the write-body; added guard to throw if childNodeId is missing

workflow: Post-merge build gate (full typecheck) is essential after parallel worktree waves — per-plan worktrees build only their package and miss consumer breakage across the monorepo
Mock-heavy test suites hide real serialization bugs — add unmocked integration tests at the layer where serialization happens, not just at the SDK mock boundary

CodeRabbit CLI review and PR-level review are complementary passes — the CLI caught 23 issues before the PR; the PR review caught 20 more (including the critical tombstone ordering bug) after reviewing the fixes
greptile's confidence score is a meaningful signal — 3/5 indicated a specific, verifiable concern (the Uint8Array serialization bug); worth investigating the named code paths rather than dismissing

When a worktree agent reports a 'pre-existing' test failure due to an unbuilt dependency, verify it's genuinely pre-existing before accepting the result — some failures require building the full chain
The cleanup-wave merge helper validates branch identity and base SHA before removing each worktree, catching base-mismatch issues before destructive removal
For single-plan waves, running directly on the main tree (no worktree) saves the pnpm install overhead with zero parallelism benefit lost
Re-run the live e2e gate after any change to rotation engine or tombstone ordering — mocked unit tests cannot catch publish-sequence bugs against the real API
When the release bot does NOT push chore(release) after Release Preview passes, the version bump may self-heal via the preview workflow's recompute — check before merge but don't block

friction: husky pre-commit hook timed out multiple commits (exit 143) requiring git log verification each time to confirm the commit actually landed
SDK_E2E_SECRET mismatch caused 401 on first live D-04 run — had to discover the actual secret from apps/api/.env

65-04's SharedWriteContext reshape under-scoped its consumer surface (context.ts, client.ts, SharedFolderState, web bridge) requiring a separate integration fix agent after the post-merge gate caught the break
CodeRabbit CLI and PR-level review together required two parallel fix waves (6 worktree agents total) before threads were clean
SCRATCH shell variable not exported to Node.js environment when using $() subshell — required inline path substitution instead of variable reference
gh pr edit blocked on Projects-classic GraphQL — required gh api -X PATCH workaround for PR body updates
Background poll exited 1 due to a transient GitHub API blip, creating a false alarm requiring manual check re-fetch
pnpm typecheck does not cover the sdk-e2e package, so pre-existing type errors there required manual investigation to confirm they were not phase-65 regressions
greptile's bin serialization bug was found only after the PR was opened and CI was green — unmocked core round-trip test should have been part of the plan's acceptance criteria
open_items: Phase 68: wire real publishedNode and writeKey values into SharedFolderState and web shared-folder-projection.ts (currently PLACEHOLDER_PUBLISHED_NODE sentinel); also make resealAndPublishParent return the updated parent envelope for SDK callers (PR threads #9/#10/#15/#17, todo: phase68-shared-write-context-publishednode-wiring.md)

Phase 66: bin-delete pin-leak — deleteFromFolder does not revoke pinned content/version CIDs (442 MB leaked); fix requires apps/api/src/shares/* which was D-02-prohibited in phase 65 (todo: 2026-06-23-bin-delete-and-empty-bin-leak-content-and-version-cid-pins.md)
Phase 66: WRITE-04 live publish-gate — 403/410 rejection of tombstoned IPNS names is currently a D-02 mock seam; the live API cutover is a Phase 66 success criterion

Test debt: e2e seed index-stability — capturedKeys[0/2] for write-chain-rotation seed identification is brittle if ECIES wrapping emits extra 32-byte randoms; fix requires a spy on generateEd25519Keypair or live IPNS probing (todo: write-chain-e2e-seed-index-stability.md)
client.ts subtree-IPNS-collect stub at lines 205/216 — non-fatal 'not implemented — phase 65 (bin re-link: subtree IPNS collect)' log; out of phase-65 scope

Pre-existing sdk-e2e type errors in batch-upload, ipns-consistency, file-operations suites from prior metadata refactor removing FolderChild/FilePointer/SealedChildRef — tracked by existing todos (remigrate-filepointer-era-e2e-helper-scripts, upload-batch-test-mock-type-drift)

32-byte input validation on sealChildWriteKey/unsealChildWriteKey (role 0x04) skipped to maintain verbatim parity with the 0x02 twin which has no guards — a broader primitives-layer validation pass would address both twins consistently
